title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears **more than once** in the array, otherwise return `false`.
hints: A brute-force check of every pair works but is O(n^2). What could remember values you've already seen?
Which data structure answers 'have I seen this value before?' in constant time on average?
Walk the array once, returning true as soon as a value is already in a set; otherwise add it.
starterCode:
class Solution:
    def hasDuplicate(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:

solution.explanation: Keep a set of values seen so far. For each number, if it is already in the set the array has a duplicate; otherwise add it. One pass, so O(n) time, and the set uses O(n) space. Sorting first and comparing neighbours is an O(n log n) time, O(1) extra space alternative.
